svg.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: How to read a Bode plot: a worked example with two poles
svg.desc: Bode plot of H(f) = 100 / ((1 + jf/100 Hz)(1 + jf/10 kHz)) from 1 Hz to 1 MHz. Top panel, magnitude in decibels: flat at 40 dB, 3 dB down at the first corner (100 Hz), then falling at 20 dB per decade to 0 dB at 10 kHz, where the second corner makes it fall at 40 dB per decade. Dashed straight-line asymptotes follow the exact curve. Bottom panel, phase in degrees: 0 degrees at low frequency, minus 45 degrees at 100 Hz, minus 90 degrees at 1 kHz, minus 135 degrees at 10 kHz and approaching minus 180 degrees.
svg.text: Worked example: H(f) = 100 / ((1 + jf/100 Hz)(1 + jf/10 kHz))
Frequency (Hz, log scale: each gridline is ten times the last)
